column1: # AIXM 4.5 to 5.1.1 code and unit lists of goaixm/aixm45to51.
# "list" lines declare a list: name, the 5.1.1 type of its values, and
# whether an unknown 4.5 value becomes OTHER with a note (other; the type
# must accept OTHER) or is invalid and dropped (closed; used for units,
# where OTHER says nothing).  "code" lines map
# one 4.5 value: list, 4.5 value, 5.1.1 value, reference.  Reference
# "goaixm" marks a goaixm proposal, to be reconciled against the official
# EUROCONTROL AICM/AIXM 4.5 to AIXM 5.1 mapping.  Tests check every 5.1.1
# value against the enumerations of the vendored 5.1.1 XSD.  Changing this
# file changes ConverterID.MappingDigest; bump Version too.
